data.title: Information panels for Predná hôrka and Klape
data.excerpt: On 30 October 2018 a new educational trail was opened at Jasenica and Udiča, and two of its panels were prepared by the Hradiská civic association. One is devoted to the Púchov culture small fort of Predná hôrka in Jasenica, the other to the hillfort of the same period on the hill of Klape.

timeline.title: The Predná hôrka and Klape panels
timeline.description: The opening of the educational trail; the Púchov culture.

children.text: On 30 October 2018 an educational trail was opened at Jasenica and Udiča. It also includes two panels prepared by our civic association Hradiská. One is devoted to the small fort of the Púchov culture at Predná hôrka in Jasenica, the other to the hillfort of the same period on the hill of Klape. The project was organised by Mr Štefan Žilovec with considerable help from the mayors of the villages involved, for which our great thanks go to them all. The ceremonial opening of the trail was attended by Mr Štefan Meliš, who discovered the Predná hôrka small fort many decades ago, as well as by Ladislav Janech with an exhibition of artefacts from his museum. It was a splendid and relaxed event with a large public turnout. Thank you.
